workItem: Implement policy-bound per-PR auto-merge, fail-closed legacy-template exclusion, and a single-writer proactive live decision dashboard.
workItemDE: Jeden Pull Request fail-closed gegen den Auto-Merge Safety Contract klassifizieren, Legacy-PR-Vorlagen vollständig von Merge/Auto-Merge ausschließen und v1.7 über denselben Evidence→Decision-Reconciler als synchrones proaktives Live Dashboard fortführen.
priorityReason: Reduziert manuelle Merge- und Synchronisationsschritte, ohne Human/CODEOWNER-Schutzklassen, Required Checks oder den kanonischen Branch-Writer zu umgehen.
exitGate: Every open same-repository PR against main is evaluated fail-closed; non-current PR template versions can never pass merge governance or auto-merge eligibility; current v1.7 Decision/Evidence state is projected into one live dashboard by the existing reconciler; only exact-head/current-base fully evidenced eligible PRs may be armed.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no direct agent self-merge and no second PR-body or branch-sync writer.
